decision_question: Does OpenRouter Qwen3 Embedding 4B recover at least three of four preregistered paraphrase anchors from the full nine-chapter book in the top five?
settings: 50 retrieval candidates, five final passages, equal-weight RRF k=60, reranker off, contextual retrieval off, no answer generation
baseline: On the same nine chapters, BM25-only retrieval found one of four exact anchors in the top five.
success: At least three of four exact anchors in the fused top five; all four runs succeed; no answer generation; <=180 seconds and <=8 GiB virtual memory.
